깎다.m: to bring down (a price), to haggle; to peel; to cut, to trim
깎다.x: I got the price down a little at the market yesterday.
깎다.e: The core idea is shaving something off: 사과를 깎다 'peel an apple', 머리를 깎다 'cut hair'.
깎다.t: At a traditional market, "좀 깎아 주세요" means "Could you give me a discount?"

답장.m: reply, written answer (to a letter, text, email)
답장.ex: 어제 보낸 문자에 아직 답장이 없어요.
답장.x: There's still no reply to the text I sent yesterday.
답장.t: Use 답장 for written replies; a spoken answer to a question is 대답.

토마토.x: I drink tomato juice every morning.

사귀다.m: to go out with, to date; to make friends
사귀다.ex: 우리는 사귄 지 일 년이 됐어요.
사귀다.x: We've been going out for a year.
사귀다.e: Covers both making friends (친구를 사귀다) and dating someone.
사귀다.t: In speech 사귀어요 is often shortened to [사겨요]; 저랑 사귈래요? means 'Will you go out with me?'

전하다.m: to pass on, to convey, to deliver (a message)
전하다.ex: 수업에 못 온 친구에게 선생님 말씀을 전했어요.
전하다.x: I passed on the teacher's message to a friend who missed class.

축하드립니다.x: Sincere congratulations to you both on your wedding.
축하드립니다.e: 축하 'celebrate and congratulate' plus humble 드리다 'give'.
축하드립니다.t: Pronounced [추카드림니다] — ㄱ+ㅎ becomes ㅋ, and ㅂ before ㄴ becomes ㅁ.

새해 복 많이 받으세요.forms: 새해 복 많이 받아 (casual) · 받으세요 (polite) · 받으십시오 (formal)
새해 복 많이 받으세요.m: Happy New Year (literally 'receive lots of blessings in the new year')
새해 복 많이 받으세요.e: Literally 'receive many blessings in the new year'.
새해 복 많이 받으세요.t: Said with a deep bow (세배) to elders on 설날; 많이 is pronounced [마니].

흘리다.m: to spill, to shed (tears, sweat); to drop (and lose)
흘리다.ex: 운동을 많이 해서 땀을 많이 흘렸어요.
흘리다.x: I worked out a lot, so I sweated a lot.
흘리다.e: Causative of 흐르다 'to flow': make something flow.

따라서.ex: 따라서 내일은 학교에서 수업을 하지 않습니다.
따라서.x: Therefore, there will be no classes at school tomorrow.

곰.x: I saw a really big bear at the zoo.
곰.e: In Korea's founding myth, a bear became a woman and gave birth to Dangun.

공장.x: They make cars at this factory every day.

줄거리.ex: 이 소설의 줄거리를 간단하게 말해 주세요.
줄거리.x: Please briefly tell me the plot of this novel.
줄거리.e: Built on 줄기 'stem, main line': the main thread of a story.

연구소.x: My older brother works at a science research institute.
연구소.e: -소 = a place for it: 연구소, 사무소, 주유소.

근로자.x: All workers have the right to rest.
근로자.e: -자 = person who does it: 근로자, 노동자, 보행자.
근로자.t: Pronounced [글로자]; 근로자 is the neutral, official term, while 노동자 can sound more political.

정책.x: The government announced a new housing policy.

무관심.x: Young people's indifference to politics is a problem.
무관심.e: 무 'without' + 관심 'interest'. 무- = 'no, without': 무료, 무책임.

해운대.ex: 여름 휴가 때 부산 해운대에 놀러 갔어요.
해운대.x: During summer vacation I went to Haeundae in Busan.
해운대.t: Korea's best-known beach. 해운대 해수욕장 = Haeundae Beach.

육아 휴직.ex: 남편이 육아 휴직을 하고 아이를 돌보고 있어요.
육아 휴직.x: My husband is on parental leave, taking care of our child.

충동구매.ex: 세일 기간에는 충동구매를 하지 않도록 조심하세요.
충동구매.x: Be careful not to buy on impulse during sales.

의료진.ex: 의료진 덕분에 환자가 빨리 회복할 수 있었어요.
의료진.x: Thanks to the medical staff, the patient was able to recover quickly.
의료진.e: Literally 'medical-treatment lineup'. -진 = a team or lineup: 취재진, 코치진.

자외선.x: UV rays are strong in summer, so put on sunscreen.
자외선.t: Sunscreen is also called 자외선 차단제, literally 'UV blocker'.

희생정신.ex: 소방관들의 희생정신은 정말 존경스러운 것 같아요.
희생정신.x: I think firefighters' spirit of self-sacrifice is truly admirable.

연이어.forms: 연이어 + verb: 연이어 발생하다, 연이어 출시되다
연이어.x: New products are being released one after another.
연이어.e: From 연잇다 'to link in a chain' (연 'connect' + 잇다 'to join').
연이어.t: Frequent in news reports about incidents or releases: 사고가 연이어 발생했습니다.

마찬가지로.m: likewise, similarly, in the same way
마찬가지로.x: Like his older brother, the younger one is also tall.

렌터카.x: On Jeju Island, we rented a car and traveled all over.
렌터카.t: Say 렌터카를 빌리다 'rent a car'; 렌트하다 is also common in speech.

근대화.ex: 한국은 짧은 시간에 빠르게 근대화를 이루었어요.
근대화.x: Korea modernized rapidly in a short time.
근대화.e: 근대 'modern era' plus -화 '-ization': 근대화, 산업화, 세계화.

악습.m: bad practice, evil custom, bad habit
악습.ex: 우리는 이런 악습을 하루빨리 없애야 합니다.
악습.x: We must get rid of this bad practice as soon as possible.

입각하다.m: to be based on, to stand on (a principle, facts)
입각하다.x: This ruling was made on the basis of the facts.
입각하다.e: Literally 'stand on your legs' — taking a firm stance on something.
입각하다.t: Fixed pattern: N에 입각하여 'grounded in N,' e.g. 사실에 입각한 보도.

척박하다.x: This land is barren, so it's hard to farm.
척박하다.t: Also used for harsh conditions: 척박한 환경 'a harsh environment'.

꿋꿋하다.ex: 그는 많은 반대에도 꿋꿋하게 자기 길을 갔어요.
꿋꿋하다.x: Despite a lot of opposition, he steadfastly went his own way.
꿋꿋하다.e: Adverb 꿋꿋이 — 꿋꿋이 버티다 'to hold out firmly' is a common pairing.

여실히.m: vividly, faithfully, just as it really is
여실히.ex: 이 사진은 전쟁의 아픔을 여실히 보여 줍니다.
여실히.x: This photo vividly shows the pain of war.
여실히.t: Almost always with 보여 주다 or 드러나다 in formal writing.

김이 새다.forms: 김이 새요 · 김이 샜어요 · 김새는 소리
김이 새다.m: to lose steam; to be a letdown; to take the fun out of something
김이 새다.ex: 영화 결말을 미리 들어서 김이 샜어요.
김이 새다.x: I heard the movie's ending ahead of time, so it was a letdown.
김이 새다.e: Literally 'the steam leaks out,' like a pot losing its heat.
김이 새다.t: Here 김 means 'steam,' not seaweed or the family name — a homonym trap.
rel: for the fun to be spoiled

판을 깨다.forms: 판을 깨요 · 판을 깼어요 · 판을 깨지 마세요
판을 깨다.m: to break up the game; to wreck a deal or gathering
판을 깨다.ex: 협상이 잘되고 있었는데 그가 판을 깼어요.
판을 깨다.x: The negotiations were going well, but he wrecked the whole thing.
판을 깨다.e: 판 = a game, scene, or setup; literally 'to break up the board.'

하이브리드.ex: 요즘은 연비가 좋은 하이브리드 차를 많이 사요.
하이브리드.x: These days many people buy fuel-efficient hybrid cars.

흑막.m: hidden scheme, behind-the-scenes intrigue, dark secret
흑막.ex: 이번 비리 사건에는 큰 흑막이 숨어 있는 것 같아요.
흑막.x: It seems there's a big hidden scheme behind this corruption case.
흑막.e: Literally 'black curtain' — what's hidden behind it.

책략.ex: 그는 뛰어난 책략으로 협상을 유리하게 이끌었어요.
책략.x: He steered the negotiations in his favor with clever tactics.
책략.t: Pronounced [챙냑] — nasalization; it can be neutral, while 계략 and 술수 lean negative.

신드롬.ex: 그 드라마는 방영 당시 엄청난 신드롬을 일으켰습니다.
신드롬.x: That drama created an enormous craze when it aired.
신드롬.e: From English 'syndrome'; in Korean media it often means a huge pop-culture phenomenon.
신드롬.t: Konglish surprise: 신드롬 usually means a massive craze, while the medical sense uses 증후군.

기억 상실.x: The main character got amnesia from an accident.
기억 상실.t: The condition is usually called 기억 상실증 (-증 'symptom, disorder'). A car accident followed by amnesia is a famous K-drama cliché.

명복.m: happiness in the afterlife (as in 명복을 빌다, 'rest in peace')
명복.x: May the deceased rest in peace.
명복.e: Literally 'underworld blessing': good fortune in the next world.
명복.t: Used almost only with 빌다 'to pray'. It is the standard condolence in speech, cards, texts and online comments.

관료제.ex: 관료제의 비효율성을 개선해야 한다는 목소리가 높아요.
관료제.x: There are growing calls to fix the inefficiency of the bureaucracy.
관료제.t: Pronounced [괄료제] — ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ.

과대망상.ex: 자기가 천재라고 믿는 건 과대망상일 수도 있어요.
과대망상.x: Believing you're a genius might be a delusion of grandeur.

알츠하이머.x: My grandfather was diagnosed with Alzheimer's last year.
알츠하이머.e: From the German doctor's name Alzheimer; the German z sound becomes 츠.
알츠하이머.t: Often said as 알츠하이머병 or 알츠하이머성 치매; 치매 is the general word for dementia.

단말기.ex: 계산할 때 카드를 단말기에 꽂아 주세요.
단말기.x: When you pay, please insert your card into the terminal.
단말기.e: Literally 'end-tip machine' — the device at the user's end of a network.
단말기.t: Used for phones in telecom contexts and for card readers at stores.

인물화.ex: 그 화가는 주로 노인들의 인물화를 그려요.
인물화.x: That painter mostly paints portraits of elderly people.

정악.m: jeongak, Korean court and aristocratic classical music
정악.x: Jeongak is characterized by its slow, graceful style.
정악.e: Literally 'proper music', in contrast to folk music (민속악).

교언영색.m: flattering words and an ingratiating face, sweet talk
교언영색.x: Don't be fooled by sweet talk; look at what people do.
교언영색.e: From Confucius: smooth talk and a fawning face rarely come with true virtue.

폐부를 찌르다.forms: 폐부를 찌르는 말 · 폐부를 찔렀다 (르 irregular)
폐부를 찌르다.m: to cut to the quick, to strike home, to pierce the heart
폐부를 찌르다.x: My teacher's single remark cut me to the quick.
폐부를 찌르다.e: Literally 'to pierce the lungs and innards' — words that reach your deepest feelings.
rel: to hit the nail on the head

하소연하다.m: to pour out one's troubles, to plead one's case, to complain (to someone)
하소연하다.ex: 친구에게 회사 일의 어려움을 한참 하소연했어요.
하소연하다.x: I poured out my troubles about work to my friend for a long time.
하소연하다.e: Looks Sino-Korean but is native; it means asking to be heard, not just griping.

몰이해.x: A lack of understanding about disability breeds discrimination.
